visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of several staghorn ferns mounted on wooden boards, displayed vertically against a white wall. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the green fronds and brown shield fronds. (2) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a grey t-shirt, is shown leaning over a shelf of small potted plants in a greenhouse setting. She looks focused on the greenery. (3) The woman holds up a small white square pot containing a young plant, smiling towards the camera. The background shows rows of similar plants on metal racks under a semi-transparent greenhouse roof. (4) In a wide shot, the woman stands in the center of a large, well-lit greenhouse with her arms raised joyfully. She is wearing a long grey dress and a pink backpack. Numerous staghorn ferns are hanging from the ceiling and walls. (5) Close-up shots follow, showing rows of small plants on shelves and the exterior of a modern, dark grey building with large glass windows, surrounded by a green lawn and large rocks. (6) A man with blue hair and a black t-shirt is shown in a workshop environment, meticulously mounting a staghorn fern onto a black plastic grid. (7) The woman is then seen sitting at a wooden table in the workshop, learning from a man with glasses. They are surrounded by bins of sphagnum moss and mounting supplies. She looks attentive as he demonstrates the technique. (8) Detailed close-ups show the process of wrapping moss around the plant's base and securing it with wire to a board. The woman smiles as she works on her own plant. (9) The blue-haired man is seen again, assisting with the mounting process while laughing. The atmosphere is casual and collaborative. (10) The woman holds up her completed mounted staghorn fern, showing a triumphant and happy expression. (11) A brief shot shows hands inspecting the base of a fern, followed by the woman posing with another woman (the shop owner) who is holding a mounted plant. (12) The final shot returns to the woman in the greenhouse, waving and gesturing enthusiastically to the surroundings.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog and promotional piece for 'Qinghua Luyuan', a staghorn fern specialty shop and garden in Tamsui. It aims to encourage plant enthusiasts, especially beginners, to visit by showcasing the beautiful environment, the variety of plants for sale, and the hands-on mounting workshops available.
